title: date cells: a due-like date on a completed record still renders red "Overdue Nd" (Done tasks flagged overdue)
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: showcase Tasks grid: *Audit current IA* (Status Done) shows Due Date `Sep 19` in red; *App wireframes* (Done) shows `Overdue 6d` in red.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

A due-like date is styled overdue whenever it is in the past, regardless of whether the record is finished, so completed work reads as late. Within a short window the text is relative ("Overdue 6d"), beyond it absolute ("Sep 19") — both red.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`resolveDueLike` in `fields/src/index.tsx` decides "due-like" from `dueLike: true` or the field-name pattern (`due`, `deadline`, `expires`, …); `isOverdueInstant` then compares only the date with today. Nothing consults the record's state.

## Expected

No overdue styling once the record is closed (a terminal status option, a `done`/`completed` boolean, or an author-declared condition).

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Let `dueLike` take a "settled when" condition (or infer from a status field's terminal option / a `done` boolean), and skip the overdue affordance when it holds.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *overdue red due date completed record done task dueLike*: 1 hits (0 open, 1 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *date cell shows overdue badge for records whose status is closed or completed*: 1 hits (0 open, 1 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11676 (closed) — same 'Done records flagged overdue' defect on the timeline view; closed 2026-10-06 by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11716 in plugin-timeline only (predates objectui 179f6fe9), so the date-cell renderer was never covered: a different surface, not a regression
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
